name: Beyond Apocalypse
description: Zombies, rifles, backpacks, motorcycles, a gyrocopter and custom player models.

notes: The analog dashboard now defaults to the lower right and is enabled for new settings. Saved preferences are retained.
Replaced the fuel bar with a dial. A separate nitrous gauge appears above the dashboard only while a bottle is installed.
Removed the vehicle name, shortened the drag hint and fixed footer text extending beyond the panel. Either Alt key can be used to drag.
Added realistic instrument faces, needles, switches and a front-facing ignition key that turns clockwise.
Fixed the realistic dashboard ignition and signal buttons.
Corrected the dashboard turn-signal and hazard indicators.
Fixed backpack quick slots duplicating an equipped weapon when dragged into storage.
Fixed the 2x sight appearing hollow outside aim-down-sights.
Hold Right Alt and drag the dashboard header to move it. Enable Realistic dashboard in F9 > Settings > Gameplay for analog gauges, an ignition key and turn signals.
Reduced repeated scope and load-menu searches. Cleaned up older changelog entries.
Shortened menus, help and descriptions. Gameplay and controls are unchanged.
Extreme Performance Mode removes decorative grass, bushes and clouds, and lowers sky and tree detail. Turning it off restores your previous settings.
Reduced rifle-switching stutter and fixed rifles briefly showing the wrong model.
Fixed the zombie limit removing the Mechanic. He now uses one slot in the limit.
Fixed a Hornet texture issue after cleaning the airframe.
Fixed guests being unable to open some Hangar computers.
Added dashboard positioning in F9 > Settings > Gameplay. Restored the Beyond Tuning nitrous gauge and boost status.
Fixed rifles disappearing or showing the wrong model in multiplayer.
Fixed wild Hornet spawns failing at blocked locations.
Fixed the Hornet fighting against a vehicle towing it.
Fixed transport, ammo and weapon attachments after loading or using Save As.
Fixed guest Hangar orders charging the host and ammo reserves being mixed up for offline players.
Fixed leftover mod state when changing worlds.
Matched the Nexus and mod manager downloads.
Fixed repeated update prompts after installing from Nexus.
Fixed the Alien and Soldier blocking the driver's view.
Restored visible arms while driving in first person.
Restored the Alien's arms and chest in first person.
Improved Alien finger movement.
Updated graphics settings support for the November 4 hotfix.
Fixed the Alien's eyes and added glowing irises.
Fixed the Alien head appearing in first person.
Alien skin paint now leaves toenails unchanged.
The Alien can now wear shirts, pants and shoes.
Added the Alien with glowing eyes.
Added a color wheel for each player model and matte or metallic finishes for the Soldier.
Fixed reserve ammo decreasing after a reload.
Moved nitrous bottles and boost to Beyond Tuning 1.2.0. Install Beyond Tuning to keep using existing bottles and buy new ones in Car Tuning > Boost.
Bottle contents stay in the game save, and Beyond Tuning imports existing nitrous records. Update both mods on every co-op player's PC.
Added the F9 player-model selector, SciFi Soldier and matching first-person arms.
Appearance choices save between sessions and remain active in vehicles. Soldier clothing is hidden; helmets remain visible to other players.
Everyone in co-op must update and restart. Separate-PC testing was still pending.
Corrected AK iron sights.
Removed repeated scenery visibility checks from Performance Mode and restored the game's normal distance culling.
Performance settings now skip unchanged values and restore previous settings when disabled.
FPS improvements varied between test scenes. Final visual testing was still pending.
Fixed rifle and nitrous textures appearing too dark in shade.
Added purple Stage II flames and stage colours to the bottle inspection display.
Replaced the barrel-sized collision shape with a bottle-sized one.
Bottles now mount horizontally; pickup, pouring and the valve follow the new position.
Added six refillable nitrous bottles: Stage I and Stage II in 2, 5 and 10 litre sizes.
Attach a filled bottle and hold Shift while driving. Braking, sharp steering and high speed limit boost; extra bottles increase supply without stacking boost power.
Added bottle loot and Hangar purchases.
Added a digital vehicle dashboard and a separate Hornet flight dashboard. Hornet flight controls are unchanged.
Remote co-op, all vehicle variants and extended sessions still needed testing.
Updated for game build 26106988.
Added F9 settings, player stats and host zombie limits of 2–40.
Reduced repeated scenery, input and trailer searches.
Improved motorcycle seating, parked wheels and removable headlights. Fixed Hornet steering after landing and smoothed its collective gauge.
Fixed rotor-blade pickup, multiplayer part fitting, Hangar purchases and saved controls.
Audio crackling after a heavily populated session remained unconfirmed. Performance gains vary by PC and scene.
Fixed missing purchase and vehicle data after a fresh Mod Manager install.
Improved motorcycles, Hangar purchases, backpacks, saved keybindings, engine fitting and rotor-blade pickup.
Reduced Performance Mode and weapon-audio loading work.
Renamed the mod folder to BeyondApocalypse and kept existing settings.
Added the Suzuki PV 50, Hangar purchases and rare motorcycle spawns.
Improved moped parts, rider posture and materials. Hold X for a wheelie.
Fixed Hangar loading and added saved Performance Mode settings in F8.
Added ammo cartons, small zombie ammo drops and uncommon world ammunition. Hangar cartons cost $300 for 30 rounds.
Added F8 melee keybindings and wider rotor-blade pickup targeting.
Improved towing stability, motorcycle wheels, rifle materials and guest Hangar purchases.
Beta release. Live towing, multiplayer, rifle lighting and parked motorcycle movement still needed testing.
Public release on Nexus Mods.
Motorcycle update.
Added simple flight, automatic hover, and gameplay and keybinding tabs in F8.
Fixed aircraft fitting and rotor-blade storage. Added F8 settings, keybindings and player stats.
Improved multiplayer aiming, rifle sounds and performance. Updated Hangar ammunition and airframes.
Improved sights, rifle sounds and handling. Fixed Hangar and airframe issues.
Hangar shop update.
Rifle controls, universal rotor blades, Hangar parts shop and 2x sights.
Graphics presets, weapon hotbar, drop position and flashlight shadow fixes.
Sprint aiming fixes, brighter weapon flashlights and zombie patrol movement.
Aiming and inventory fixes, brighter weapon lights and idle zombie wandering.
Weapon aiming and flashlights, backpack drop fixes and more responsive collective.
Smoother flight, collective gauge, backpack storage-drop fix and tougher Mechanic.
Slower Mechanic with immediate pursuit and attack recovery.
Mechanic night hunter.
Flight balance and collective gauge.
Manual flight and engine/turbo performance.
Mod update with Launcher 1.1.
Fixed backpack removal and guest inventory refresh. Improved multiplayer docking.
Separated the player release package from development tools.
Unloading refits original racked blades and frees the trailer for another Hornet.
Fixed a multiplayer crash while syncing rotor blades.
Improved aircraft movement and rotor-blade fitting in multiplayer.
Fixed docking collisions, delayed attachments and trailer weight in multiplayer.
Restored the missing heli-trailer landing pad.
Fixed guests fitting rotor blades and standing on landing pads.
Fixed aircraft and rotor-blade identification and docking in multiplayer.
Adjusted landing-pad trim and stopped Hornet audio when the engine is off.
Fixed docking while hovering and towing.
Added removable rotor blades and separate Trailer and Heli trailer choices.
Fixed blade pickup alignment and left-click attachment.
Hornet carrier deck, removable main blades and docking/rack storage.
Hornet radiator and battery mounting positions retained after refitting.
Fixed conflicting flight controls for climbing, descending and banking.
Assisted vertical flight and restored rotor/propeller visibility.
Added the single-seat Hornet gyrocopter and rare airframe spawns.
Added Hazmat zombies with lower-detail models at a distance.
Multiplayer backpack lookup and transfer feedback fixes.
